verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a native Slack channel integration, a Notion integration, or a Zapier app for pushing notes. Slack appears only as a meeting source (Slack Huddles recording), not as a destination. The REST API and webhooks are developer building blocks someone could use to construct such flows, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a product manager, notes flow into the tools where work happens — Slack channels, Notion pages, and thousands of apps via Zapier
